description: List all workspaces available in the current Asana session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of workspace objects (gid, resource_type, name); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List users, optionally filtered to a single workspace.

workspace_gid.description: Optional workspace gid to filter users by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of user objects (gid, resource_type, name, email); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List projects, optionally filtered by workspace and archived state.

workspace_gid.description: Optional workspace gid to filter projects by.

archived.description: Optional archived flag; when set, only projects matching this archived state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of project objects (gid, name, owner, color, archived, notes, created_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single project by its gid.

project_gid.description: The unique gid of the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the project object; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the sections belonging to a project.

project_gid.description: The unique gid of the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of section objects; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the tasks belonging to a project.

project_gid.description: The unique gid of the project.

completed_since.description: Optional ISO timestamp; reserved filter for tasks completed since a given time.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of task views; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: List tasks, optionally filtered by project, assignee, and completion state.

project_gid.description: Optional project gid to filter tasks by.

assignee_gid.description: Optional assignee (user) gid to filter tasks by.

completed.description: Optional completion flag; when set, only tasks matching this completed state are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of task views; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single task by its gid.

task_gid.description: The unique gid of the task.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the task view; on failure (task not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new task, optionally attached to a project/section and assigned to a user.

project_gid.description: Optional project gid the task belongs to.

section_gid.description: Optional section gid within the project.

assignee_gid.description: Optional user gid to assign the task to.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for the task.

completed.description: Whether the task is created in a completed state (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created task view; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing task by its gid.

task_gid.description: The unique gid of the task to update.

name.description: Optional new name for the task.

due_on.description: Optional new due date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated task view; on failure (task not found), output contains an error message.
